articles.title: Yemeni minister says young girl injured in Houthi shelling in Taiz
articles.description: ADEN: Muammar Al-Eryani, Yemen’s information minister, has said that a young girl was injured when a shell fired by Houthi forces struck her family’s home in Taiz. In a post on X on Friday night, Al-Eryani said the child, Nouf, had been playing inside her family’s home in the Old Airport area of the city when the shell hit. articles.title: Two Civilians Killed, Two Injured in Houthi Shelling of Taiz Villages
articles.description: A man and a girl were killed, and two others injured on Saturday when Houthi militia shelled villages in Haifan District, south of Taiz.
